purpose: Semantic check of docs/research/domino-warmstart-scaling-v1.json: explicit equations, which quantity each constant is, what the run_1 evidence does and does not establish, and the error factors of the earlier conversion. It adds limits; it changes no channel status.

constants.u_norm_meaning: velocity normalisation divisor from the checkpoint's global_parameters.inlet_velocity.reference; NOT the operating speed of the training data
constants.rho_norm_meaning: density used only as a pressure divisor; the source pMeanTrim is kinematic (density 1), so this constant is not an air density of the data
constants.training_freestream_meaning: DrivAerML freestream; the physical operating point of the labels (pMeanTrim / CpMeanTrim = 0.5 * 38.889^2)
constants.channel_order_source: volume config.yaml variables.volume.solution: UMeanTrim (vector), pMeanTrim (scalar), nutMeanTrim (scalar)

conversions.statistical_inverse: f_hat_c = (y_c + 1) / 2 * (max_c - min_c) + min_c, scaling_factors.pkl volume_fields, unclamped
conversions.reference_velocity: U_ref_sample = u_norm * (f_hat_0, f_hat_1, f_hat_2) = 30 * U_hat  [m/s, at the training sample's 38.889 m/s conditions]
conversions.reference_pressure: p_kin_ref_sample = rho_norm * u_norm^2 * f_hat_3 = 1084.5 * p_hat  [m^2/s^2, kinematic, relative to p_ref = 0]; no division by any density
conversions.to_openfoam: p_OpenFOAM = p_kin + c, with c an additive gauge fitted to the control case far field in m^2/s^2; OpenFOAM incompressible p is already kinematic, so no density appears
conversions.to_pascal_reporting_only: p_Pa = rho_air * p_kin, one multiplication by the case air density (1.184 for Vernon's case); never used for import
conversions.operating_point_hypothesis: s = U_case / 38.889; U_case_field = s * 30 * U_hat; p_case = s^2 * 1084.5 * p_hat (+ gauge). Assumes Reynolds independence; gated by audit normalization.operating_point_gate (unresolved)

earlier_conversion_errors.plan_6_2_formula: p_dynamic_Pa = rho * U_ref^2 * p_hat; p_OpenFOAM = (p_dynamic_Pa - p_ref) / rho, with U_ref = case speed
earlier_conversion_errors.density_division: Treats p_hat as Pa over rho*U^2 and divides by rho: gives u_norm^2 * p_hat = 900 * p_hat at the reference conditions, too small by the factor rho_norm = 1.205. The source was never multiplied by a density, so dividing by one is the extra division.
earlier_conversion_errors.case_speed_as_u_ref: Using U_ref = 16 m/s for the 30 m/s divisor: velocity 16 * U_hat instead of 12.343 * U_hat, 29.6 % fast (freestream 20.74 m/s)
earlier_conversion_errors.combined_pressure_at_16_mps: rho*16^2*p_hat/rho = 256 * p_hat instead of 183.58 * p_hat, factor 1.3945 = (38.889/30)^2 / 1.205
earlier_conversion_errors.status_in_code: Not present in any import path (none exists). scripts/ai/domino_warmstart_scaling.py::pressure_to_kinematic gives the correct 1084.5 * p_hat only when called with rho = 1.205, U_ref = 30 and 'kinematic_over_rho_u_squared'; its signature also accepts the case density and speed silently. scripts/ai/domino_warmstart_units.py binds the constants to the audit and is the conversion an import must use.
earlier_conversion_errors.p_reference_quirk: pressure_to_kinematic(..., 'kinematic_over_rho_u_squared') converts a Pa gauge with the normalisation density 1.205, which is not the air density of either case. Harmless at p_reference = 0; domino_warmstart_units.py takes gauges in m^2/s^2 only.

evidence_classification.run_1_reference_parity: label_regression_identification: fits of surrogate predictions against DrivAerML run_1 CFD labels. It identifies the normalisation structure; the 0.10 / 0.13 relative L2 values are prediction error against labels (surrogate error included), not implementation error.

software_parity.reason: No reference-implementation outputs for identical input tensors exist locally (plan 6.4 rtol 1e-5 / atol 1e-6 comparison). The bridge and the parity script share the same installed PhysicsNeMo 1.3.0 datapipe call, so agreement between them is not independent.

evidence_classification.discriminating_power: About +-5 %: it separates the structural candidates (x1.205 extra division 15 %, factor two 58 %, 38.889 m/s 72 %) but not rho_norm 1.205 from the case air density 1.184 (2 %); 1.205 comes from config.yaml, not from the fit.

reading.Uz: independently fitted 29.807 m/s (+0.65 %), sign confirmed (flipped rel L2 1.97 vs 0.21)
reading.Uy: sign consistent (correlation 0.92), magnitude not independently tested: on the y = 0 plane Uy is the label's small asymmetry (rms 2.5 m/s), the fit gives 39.8 m/s (-25 %). Uy rests on the shared-divisor convention of a vector channel.
reading.order: identity order 0.103; best alternative (Uy and Uz swapped) 0.327, x3.2; any order moving Ux is above 1.36
reading.pressure: gauge-free divisor 1060.5 m^2/s^2, with-gauge 1060.7: kinematic 1084.5 is +2.3 %; the extra density division (900) is -15.1 %, the factor two (450) -57.6 %. With a global median gauge the rel L2 margin over the extra division is 0.195 / 0.128 = 1.52x, close to the 1.5x preregistered margin (which used an upstream gauge: 0.244 / 0.128 = 1.90x).

limitations: One sample and one plane; run_1 may be a training case.
Identification at 38.889 m/s says nothing about the 16 m/s case; the operating-point gate stays unresolved.
Software parity against a reference implementation is not established.
These checks are post hoc; they limit or support the audit, they do not verify it.
